body:
# Terah Chambers

# Board of Education Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/terah-chambers.jpg)

[Voted for](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/6ce7c4c6-495b-4a6a-9e39-87c547dd5e1c/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Transgender-policy-5106-East-Lansing-vote-minutes.png?language=en) the [district’s transgender policy](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/d7349534-7bae-4984-8932-6ac9c10d217b/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/File_-5106-Transgender-Students_revised_1-23-23.pdf?language=en) in 2023. The policy said the following:

- Voted to enact a policy that: “The person best suited to determine a student’s Gender Identity is the individual student. A student is not required to present legal or medical documentation of a gender transition when the student notifies the District of his, her, or their Gender Identity, chosen name, or pronouns”
- “The District will ensure that all staff engage in reasonable and good faith efforts to address the student by the student’s chosen name and pronouns.”
- “A student may not have informed parents of the student’s Gender Identity. In that situation, disclosure to a student’s parents should be carefully considered on a case-by case basis. Administrators should involve the school counselor or social worker and consider the health, safety, and well-being of the student, as well as the school’s responsibility to keep parents informed, before making any disclosure.”
- “Upon request, students will have access to the facilities that correspond with their gender identity and may also choose to use single-user or gender-neutral restrooms.”

Authored [a book](https://web.archive.org/web/20260216003437/https:/www.terahchambers.com/) called *Racial Opportunity Cost *which refers to “the obstacles faced and tradeoffs made by Black and Latinx students on the path to academic success.”

Chambers is the [Associate Dean for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://web.archive.org/web/20260216003437/https:/www.terahchambers.com/) at Michigan State University.

Chambers website touts her presentation “I Can’t Breathe: Surviving the Dual Pandemics of Racism and Covid-19”

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/Picture1.png)

Chambers is proud to be endorsed for the Board of Education by Planned Parenthood and said, “uphold the sexual and reproductive rights of all ELPS students should I be re-elected to the school board.”

![](/media/uploads/2026/10/Picture2.png)
